newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices in modest recovery.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices in modest recovery.

text.p: Indian cotton prices gained in a modest recovery on Thursday on fresh mill enquiries and easing pressure of new crop arrivals, dealers said.
"Expectations that the government may allow more export of cotton also helped the recovery," one broker said.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi rose from 810/830 rupees to 820/850 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned rose by 20 rupees to 1,420/1,580 rupees. Long-staple Gujarat Sankar-4 remained steady at 17,500/18,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
New crop arrivals in the Punjab region fell to 25,000 bales against 30-35,000 bales reported on Wednesday.
